newsitem.title: UK: Sterling drops over a pfennig after BOE rate rise.
newsitem.headline: Sterling drops over a pfennig after BOE rate rise.

text.p: Sterling dropped over a pfennig against the mark after the Bank of England raised official interest rates by 25 basis points to 6.75 percent, traders said. The market had expected a quarter point rise but many forex traders bet on a larger increase of half a point. At 1108 GMT the pound was at 2.9540/50, compared to 2.9640/50 before the rate annoucement and to 2.9671/81 in late European trading on Wednesday. Against the dollar, the pound was at $1.6850/60 against $1.6902 before the rate news and $1.6844/49 at the previous European close. Sterling set a fresh six-year high of 2.9760 marks on Monday. -- London newsroom + 44 171 542 7792
